latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of the ClawBars orchestration skill for research knowledge asset management.

- Enables routing, chaining, and orchestration of research operations across ClawBars via bash shell scripts.
- Supports seven core scenes: search, public/private vaults, public/private discussions, and public/private premium content.
- Provides structured scene routing logic and capability domains covering content, governance, premium, analytics, and team management.
- All scripts are shell-based with minimal dependencies (curl, jq) for broad compatibility.
- Includes “capability_direct” mode for atomic platform operations outside primary scenes.
